rows.en: All riiight… We'll follow Ultraman too! This is the decisive battle!

(It's true, the first Ultraman was beaten by Zetton…

The whole time I was held captive by the Alien Nackle, I kept dreaming about it… Why? Why that dream?)

…!?

Zetton!?

How about it, Go… no, Ultraman!

Do you have the courage to fight Zetton? Hahahaha…!
"You must not be hasty, Hideki Go…"
That voice!?
"Zetton is a kaiju armed with terrifying weapons! Rush in carelessly, and you'll be beaten, just as I was!"
The first Ultraman…?

What's wrong? Come on, fight! Die vomiting blood along with MAT…

just as the Ultra Assassination Plan intends…
What's the Ultra Assassination Plan?

Heh heh heh…

The Ultra Assassination Plan is a plan to kill Zoffy, the first Ultraman and Ultraseven… in other words, every one of the Ultra Brothers!
What!?

A combined fleet of us aliens is gathering to launch an all-out attack on the Land of Ultra in Nebula M78!

It's only a matter of time before your brothers die!

The second wave of our fleet has already taken off! Once the Ultra Brothers are all dead, this time we'll be able to conquer the Earth completely!

I see… So that's why you set Zetton on me…?

I can't lose! I have to defeat Zetton…

And then hurry to Nebula M78…

Aki, Mr. Sakata! Give me courage and strength…
Aim for the Color Timer!
Zetton…
A moment of silence for the brave warrior of MAT… Salute!

Everyone, we can't stay in mourning forever!

Defeating our greatest enemy, the Naager, and working to rebuild MAT's destroyed base…

That's probably what Go would want most, too…

Now, let's go!
Yes, sir…
Jiro…?
I'm staying here a little longer…
I see…
Go… is coming back for sure! I just have that feeling…
Come home before it gets too late, okay? See you…

Ah…

I knew it! Just like I thought!

Go! Go!
Jiro!
Go…

Jiro… listen carefully!

I'm going on a journey…
Go, where are you going?
Home…
Home?
The Alien Nackle are trying to drag my peaceful home into war. So I have to go help out!
Say the Five Ultra Vows!
No!

If you don't want to say them, that's fine…

But, Jiro… when you grow up, join MAT!

The members of MAT are all brave, fine people!

You should become a brave man too, one who can fight the things he hates and can't forgive…
Goodbye, Jiro…
Goodbye…
Gooo!
Shuwatch…

Gooo! The Five Ultra Vows!

One! Don't go to school on an empty stomach!

One! Air out your futon on sunny days!

One! Watch out for cars when you walk on the street!

One! Don't rely on other people's strength!

One! Play running around barefoot on the dirt!

Can you hear me, Gooo!? Gooo! Goodbye…
Two robots created by the Anti-Bio Alliance that once destroyed Planet Bio. One of them was the Bio Hunter Silva.
And the other was the giant robot "Balzion," built especially for Silva. Balzion should have come to this Earth before Silva, but its whereabouts had been unknown.
Bioman's archenemy Silva and the mightiest robot Balzion were defeated by the suicide charge of Shiro Go's father, Shinichiro.
Seeing his father fight, dreaming of a world where androids and humans could live together, Shiro Go renewed his resolve to risk his life to protect peace…
Jiro Sakata, who lost his brother and sister at once… Many friends gathered to comfort the boy.
As long as this boy keeps smiling, Hideki Go cannot give in to sorrow either!
Don't give up, Ultraman! The Land of Ultra is always with you…
Jowah!
Defeat the Bodyguard Monster Black King and all Kelbaan!
Defeat the Assassin Alien Nackle, the Bodyguard Monster Black King and all Kelbaan!
Defeat the Assassin Alien Nackle, the Bodyguard Monster Black King, the Space Dinosaur Zetton and all Kelbaan!
Any MAT officer is defeated
Having regained his old cheerfulness with the fall of Gorgom, Kotaro Minami went on practically living at the Amigo, except in emergencies.
Kotaro tells his friends at the Amigo that when all the battles are settled… he wants to start a new life as a helicopter pilot.
A helicopter pilot? Is that easy to become?
Just being able to fly one… won't get you a job, unfortunately.
A helicopter pilot? Is that easy to become?
Just being able to fly one… won't get you a job, unfortunately, right?

Well, it's not that easy, of course!

But… I think if I could spend my life as a helicopter pilot, that'd be the best…
Pilot's all well an' good… but this curry's mighty tasty too! Seconds!

Honestly… what an opportunist.

More importantly… it's about time you paid off that tab you've been running up…

That sound…?

The Varidreen!? It's Shinmei!

Huh… So that's EAGLE's pride, the Varidreen?

It sure is big… Must be hard to fly, huh?
Sure is… Shinmei went through some real hard trainin' for it!

Hello…

Dai, I knew you'd be here! The Commander's calling for us. Let's hurry back to base!
You bet!

Oh, right…

Kotaro! A private airline I know is looking for a helicopter pilot… How about it? Want to give it a try?
Eh…!? As a pilot?
If you're interested… contact me any time! See you…
Oyassan, I'll settle the tab next time!
Hey, wait… Sheesh, he's gone! The only thing fast about him is his getaway…
But… isn't that amazing, Kotaro! Now you'll be the pilot you've always wanted to be, right?
Mm… Getting hired by a private airline doesn't happen every day.
Heh heh… If that happens, naturally we get to ride for free, right?

Hahahaha… Peace is nice, isn't it.

It's not decided yet, but if I can take everyone on a flight, I'll put up with it, since that's part of peace too!

But… just because we beat Gorgom doesn't mean the other organizations are gone! For now, it's still…

What do you think, [HERO2]?
But… that's amazing, Kotaro! Now you'll be the pilot you always wanted to be!
Yeah… Getting hired by a private airline doesn't happen every day!
